_comment: Every screenshot the guides use, retaken by scripts/screenshots.mjs against the app on a fresh docs seed (volt-app/scripts/seed-docs.ts). A shot is a console path, what to wait for, and optionally an element to crop to, elements to hide and clicks to make first. Images land in static/img/screens/<name>.png; guides show them with ![...](/img/screens/<name>.png).

shots.name: account-settings
shots.alt: The Account settings page, with the logo and colours at the top

shots.name: audit-log
shots.alt: The Audit log page listing recent changes, newest first

shots.name: dashboard
shots.alt: The Dashboard: five counts across the top, then the attention list, streams on air, the last seven days and recent output

shots.name: live-streams
shots.alt: The Live Streams board: counts across the top, then one row per running stream with its five gates

shots.name: monitoring
shots.alt: The Monitoring page: severity counts, the alert list and fleet activity

shots.name: multiview
shots.alt: Multiview: the output and viewer location choices, grid size, and a tile per running stream

shots.name: channels
shots.alt: The Channels list: type and status filters, then one row per channel with its type, status and a Start or Stop button

shots.name: channel-new
shots.alt: The New channel form: name and logo, Transcode or Packaging with the group, then the source or the renditions you send

shots.name: channel-status
shots.alt: A channel page: the overall status beside the name, the five gates under it, then the source and output players
shots._why: The docs seed leaves News 24 recorded as running with no encoder behind it, so its page shows real gates: starting just after the API comes up, a failed Server gate with the Diagnose banner after about 90 seconds.

shots.name: radio
shots.alt: The Radio list: status filters, then one row per station with now playing, signal, outputs and status

shots.name: events
shots.alt: The Events list: status filters, list and calendar views, then one row per event with its window, status, recording and replay settings

shots.name: fast-new
shots.alt: The New FAST channel form: name, video or audio, group and time zone

shots.name: fast-run-order
shots.waitFor: h3:has-text('What this run order does to a week')
shots.alt: A FAST channel's Run order: the library of titles and series on the left, what the run order does to a week, then the series slot and the film slot

shots.name: fast-week
shots.alt: The Week tab: seven days side by side, every programme of the coming week at its start time on the half-hour grid

shots.name: epg
shots.alt: The EPG list: one row per channel, station and event guide, with how many programmes it has, how far ahead it is filled and what is next

shots.name: loops-and-fillers
shots.alt: The Loops & Fillers page: the upload area at the top, then the list of loops and slates with a preview, what uses each one, its size and status
shots._why: The docs seed adds a slate (used by News 24) and a loop, so the list is not the empty state.

shots.name: graphics
shots.alt: The Graphics page: counts of templates, setups and what is on air, the four tabs, and the template library with a preview of each

shots.name: captions
shots.alt: The Captions page: the engine for the account at the top, then a card for each output profile with its languages and who uses it

shots.name: formats-and-reframing
shots.alt: The Formats and reframing page: output formats and what to keep in frame on the left, publish targets and when it runs on the right

shots.name: media-library
shots.alt: The Media Library page: the upload band at the top, the search, sort and filter chips, then the list of assets with their review, QC and availability

shots.name: recordings
shots.alt: The Recordings page: filter chips for channels, radio, events and what is recording now, then one row per source with its recordings, available range, content held and status

shots.name: image-library
shots.alt: The Image Library: the folder tree on the left, the search box and filters at the top, and a grid of images with their usage type, size and folder

shots.name: review
shots.alt: The Review page: the queue of clips with their source, length, QC result and review state, one clip opened to show what was measured and the decision buttons

shots.name: share-links
shots.alt: The Share window: how to send it, how long it lasts, who can open it and a label, with the links already made for this stream listed below
shots._why: The Share window over the channel page; the window has no dialog role to crop to, so the shot is the whole page.

shots.name: encoding-profiles
shots.alt: The Encoding profiles page: the list of renditions with the form to add one, the New ladder card, and a ladder with its rungs and the preview of what a source would get

shots.name: watchfolders
shots.alt: A watchfolder's page: its path and Scan now button, the numbered rules with the one that would win highlighted, the Try a filename box, and the queue of files that need a person

shots.name: storage
shots.alt: The Storage page: what this service can do at the top, the retention ladder, event data retention, the dry run, and the list of media with its state, tier and size

shots.name: workflows
shots.alt: The Workflows page: the counts of runs, the Map, Runs and Add-ons and triggers tabs, and the pipeline map with its three lanes, stages and hooks

shots.name: content-types
shots.alt: The Content Types page: the list of types on the left with filters for what each is offered for, and the field editor for the chosen type on the right

shots.name: publishing-rules
shots.alt: The Publishing Rules page: the publishing points, the account default with each of its fields, and the lists of content type and channel, event or station overrides

shots.name: ingest-rules
shots.alt: The Ingest Rules page: the platform baseline, the account default, content type and source or folder rungs with their rules, then linked cloud accounts and webhooks

shots.name: channel-groups
shots.alt: The Channel groups page: the plan strip with what is shared out, then the table of groups with their workflow, output profile, share of the plan and events

shots.name: analytics
shots.alt: The Audience view: watching now, views, unique viewers, watch hours and peak concurrent across the top, then views and unique viewers by day

shots.name: plan-and-limits
shots.alt: The Plan & limits page: the plan name, three meters for channels and stations, shared out to groups and running at once, then the table of groups

shots.name: fleet-and-usage
shots._why: Shown as a customer account sees it (customerView): the server's setting names and machine names are only for whoever runs the Volt deployment (build queue 1.14-G4a).
shots.alt: The Fleet & Usage page: servers now, billable today, this month and all time across the top, one server with its load, then billable time by day

shots.name: payments
shots.alt: The Payments page: four provider cards, the products made from your access rules with each provider's id, and the viewer look-up

shots.name: social-accounts
shots._why: Shown as a customer account sees it (customerView): the server's setting names and machine names are only for whoever runs the Volt deployment (build queue 1.14-G4a).
shots.alt: The Social accounts page: one card per platform, YouTube with a linked sandbox account, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Dailymotion, and X off at the bottom with Use your own X app

shots.name: notifications
shots._why: Shown as a customer account sees it (customerView): the server's setting names and machine names are only for whoever runs the Volt deployment (build queue 1.14-G4a).
shots.alt: The Notifications page: the three delivery channels with a test button each, the sent list with one alert, the templates and your devices

shots.name: users-and-roles
shots.alt: The Users & Roles page on Admin users: the two-step sign-in policy, then the account's people with their roles, tier, two-step sign-in and status

shots.name: permissions-map
shots.alt: The Permissions map: one column per kind of user, one row per area of Volt, with None, View, Operate or Manage in each cell

shots.name: api-keys-and-apps
shots.alt: The API Keys & Apps page: the registered apps with their platform, key prefix and requests, then the server-to-server secret keys
